name: es20-mipmaps
title: Mipmaps: level of detail, the four mipmap filters, glGenerateMipmap, completeness
summary: Hand-made mip chains sampled at exactly chosen levels of detail with all four mipmap filters, BASE/MAX_LEVEL and MIN/MAX_LOD, glGenerateMipmap and its hint, and seven kinds of incomplete mip chain, checked against the range a CPU model of ES 3.0 equations 3.16-3.25 guarantees (filter and blend weights only measured).
spec: ES 3.0 §3.8.10.1 Scale Factor and Level of Detail (equations 3.16-3.21)
ES 3.0 §3.8.10.2 Coordinate Wrapping and Texel Selection (Table 3.22)
ES 3.0 §5.3 Hints, Table 6.27 (hint state), Table 6.9 (texture state)
GLSL ES 3.00 §8.8 Texture Lookup Functions (texture, textureSize)

api.glGenTextures: ladder, stripes and checker textures, 14 scenario textures and scratch textures; each becomes a texture object when first bound
api.glBindTexture: TEXTURE_2D binding selects the texture each cell samples; verified through the sampled colours
api.glTexImage2D: every mip level uploaded by hand (levels 0-6 of two 64x64 textures); wrong-size and wrong-format levels make the chain incomplete; RGBA8UI/DEPTH_COMPONENT24 bases for the glGenerateMipmap error; sampled colours compared with the CPU model
api.glTexParameteri: TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER (four mipmap filters, read back and observed through level selection), TEXTURE_BASE_LEVEL and TEXTURE_MAX_LEVEL (observed through level selection and completeness; -1 -> INVALID_VALUE)
api.glTexParameterf: TEXTURE_MIN_LOD / TEXTURE_MAX_LOD clamp lambda (observed through level selection)
api.glGetTexParameteriv: MIN_FILTER readback of all four mipmap filters; initial BASE_LEVEL 0, MAX_LEVEL 1000, MIN_FILTER NEAREST_MIPMAP_LINEAR
api.glGenerateMipmap: derived level sizes (textureSize, incl. 37x21), base level unchanged, derived levels identical over two different stale contents (replaced regardless of previous contents), levels beyond MAX_LEVEL untouched, texture complete afterwards (before: black), INVALID_OPERATION for RGBA8UI and DEPTH_COMPONENT24 bases
api.glHint: GENERATE_MIPMAP_HINT FASTEST/NICEST/DONT_CARE; independence of the derived levels from stale content checked under each value
api.glGetIntegerv: GENERATE_MIPMAP_HINT initial value DONT_CARE and read-back of each hint value (meta-gl gap G2)
api.glDrawArrays: TRIANGLE_STRIP quad per cell; every pixel of every cell compared
api.glViewport: per-cell viewport maps each strip to its cell; pixel positions verified
api.glUniform1f: s0 / s range / t of the strip: sets lambda exactly; verified by the selected level
api.glUniform1i: sampler unit, sampling mode and lod of the textureSize probe (sizes verified)
api.glReadPixels: RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE readback of the default framebuffer for all comparisons

visual_review.notes: radeonsi es-max capture (viewed at 3x): rows 0-1 show red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, magenta, magenta (level 6 twice); rows 2-3 the intermediate blends; rows 4-5 are rows 0-1 shifted by a quarter/three quarters of a level; rows 6-9 show vertical colour stripes that end in a flat colour where a small level runs out; row 10 shows yellow|blue halves for the generated levels 0-5 and one grey mean colour at the 1x1 level; rows 11-12 show seven black|colour pairs plus two empty cells; rows 13-14 show the BASE/MAX_LEVEL and MIN/MAX_LOD variants. llvmpipe and zink captures differ by at most 1/255.
